Print a residual Moran's I result

Source: R/evaluation.R
print.morans_i.Rd

Shows the statistic, the null its moments come from and the evidence behind them. The weight matrix the result carries gets a one-line description in place of the matrix: it is \(n \times n\), and autoprinting it buried the statistic under a thousand lines of matrix.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'morans_i'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class morans_i, from residual_morans_i().

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

Other print methods: print.aoa(), print.gwr_model_selection(), print.resolution_profile(), print.sac_range()
